title: Madness
statementMd:
The second semester starts at the University of Pavlopolis. After vacation in Vičkopolis Noora needs to return to Pavlopolis and continue her study.

Sometimes (or quite often) there are teachers who do not like you. Incidentally Noora also has one such teacher. His name is Yury Dmitrievich and he teaches graph theory. Yury Dmitrievich doesn't like Noora, so he always gives the girl the most difficult tasks. So it happened this time.

The teacher gives Noora a tree with $*n*$ vertices. Vertices are numbered with integers from $1$ to $*n*$. The length of all the edges of this tree is $1$. Noora chooses a set of simple paths that pairwise don't intersect in edges. However each vertex should belong to at least one of the selected path.

For each of the selected paths, the following is done:

1. We choose **exactly** one edge $(*u*, *v*)$ that belongs to the path.
2. On the selected edge $(*u*, *v*)$ there is a point at some selected distance $*x*$ from the vertex $*u*$ and at distance $1 - *x*$ from vertex $*v*$. But the distance $*x*$ chosen by Noora arbitrarily, i. e. it can be different for different edges.
3. One of the vertices $*u*$ or $*v*$ is selected. The point will start moving to the selected vertex.

Let us explain how the point moves by example. Suppose that the path consists of two edges $(*v*_{1}, *v*_{2})$ and $(*v*_{2}, *v*_{3})$, the point initially stands on the edge $(*v*_{1}, *v*_{2})$ and begins its movement to the vertex $*v*_{1}$. Then the point will reach $*v*_{1}$, then "turn around", because the end of the path was reached, further it will move in another direction to vertex $*v*_{2}$, then to vertex $*v*_{3}$, then "turn around" again, then move to $*v*_{2}$ and so on. The speed of the points is $1$ edge per second. For example, for $0.5$ second the point moves to the length of the half of an edge.

A stopwatch is placed at each vertex of the tree. The time that the stopwatches indicate at start time is $0$ seconds. Then at the starting moment of time, all points simultaneously start moving from the selected positions to selected directions along the selected paths, and stopwatches are simultaneously started. When one of the points reaches the vertex $*v*$, the stopwatch at the vertex $*v*$ is automatically reset, i.e. it starts counting the time from zero.

Denote by $*res*_{*v*}$ the maximal time that the stopwatch at the vertex $*v*$ will show if the point movement continues infinitely. Noora is asked to select paths and points on them so that $*res*_{1}$ is as minimal as possible. If there are several solutions to do this, it is necessary to minimize $*res*_{2}$, then $*res*_{3}$, $*res*_{4}, ..., *res*_{*n*}$.

Help Noora complete the teacher's task.

For the better understanding of the statement, see the explanation for the example.

## Input

The first line contains single integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — number of vertices in the given tree.

Each of next $*n* - 1$ lines contains two integers $*u*$ and $*v*$ ($1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*, *u* ≠ *v*$) — vertices connected by an edge.

Guaranteed that input defines a valid tree.

## Output

In the first line print single integer $*paths*$ — number of paths you want to choose.

In the next $*paths*$ lines print path's descriptions:

1. Single integer $*len*$ — number of edges in the current path.
2. $*len*$ integers — indices of the edges in the path. The edges are numbered from $1$ to $*n* - 1$ in order they are given in input.
3. Two integers $*u*$ and $*v*$ — means that you put point on the edge between vertices $*u*$ and $*v*$ (obviously the edge should belong to the path) and a point will start moving to the vertex $*v*$. Note that **order of printing of the edge's ends is important**. For example if you print "`1 2`" (without quotes), then point will start moving to vertex $2$; but if you print "`2 1`" (without quotes), then point will start moving to vertex $1$.
4. Single real number $*x*$ ($0 ≤ *x* ≤ 1$) — distance between point and vertex $*u*$ **(the same vertex that you print first in the third paragraph)**.

## Scoring

Judge system will generate array $*res*$ using the output data provided by the participant. Also system will generate array $*resOptimal*$ by the jury answer. Your answer will be accepted if only for each $*i*$ ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) the following is satisfied: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2645e3d4fa7e9bd561bf0afa6404827f5aca795a.png).

## Note

Consider an example.

In starting moment of time points are located as following:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/94c0e438632ed2dc123fea299e59aea2371e6a06.png)

The first path is highlighted in red, the second in blue, green circles represent chosen points, and brown numbers inside vertices — current time at stopwatch. Purple arrows represent direction in which points will move.

In $0.(3)$ seconds points will be located in following way (before stopwatch reset):

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fd3a46e3dd4a58ac03602f25b15b1306879aa612.png)

After stopwatch reset:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/accaa16983b2ddaca97bd199ce312425c62ea6b7.png)

In $1.0$ second after the start of moving:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/69ed4a6243b76dbc1262954fa7e58465098e54a5.png)

In $1.(3)$ seconds after the start of moving (after stopwatch reset):

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/440fc4e17e82c7f8cd6f402d105169db406b6466.png)

Finally, in $2$ seconds after the start of moving points return to their initial positions.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e96048db37d885902e00d696449f4f5be537b221.png)

This process will continue infinitely.
statementZhMd:
<statement>

帕夫洛波利斯大学的第二学期开始了。假期结束后，Noora 需要回到帕夫洛波利斯继续学习。

有时（或者说相当经常）会有老师不喜欢你。碰巧 Noora 也有这样一位老师。他的名字叫 Yury Dmitrievich，教授图论。Yury Dmitrievich 不喜欢 Noora，所以总是给这个女孩布置最困难的任务。这一次也不例外。

老师给 Noora 一棵有 $*n*$ 个顶点的树。顶点编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数。这棵树的所有边长度均为 $1$。Noora 选择若干条两两没有公共边的简单路径。不过，每个顶点都必须至少属于一条被选中的路径。

对于每一条被选中的路径，都进行如下操作：

1. 选择路径中**恰好**一条边 $(*u*, *v*)$。
2. 在选中的边 $(*u*, *v*)$ 上放置一个点，该点到顶点 $*u*$ 的距离为某个选定的距离 $*x*$，到顶点 $*v*$ 的距离为 $1 - *x*$。Noora 可以任意选择距离 $*x*$，也就是说，不同边上的点可以有不同的初始位置。
3. 选择顶点 $*u*$ 或 $*v*$ 中的一个。该点将开始向选中的顶点移动。

下面通过一个例子来说明点的移动方式。假设路径由两条边 $(*v*_{1}, *v*_{2})$ 和 $(*v*_{2}, *v*_{3})$ 组成，点最初位于边 $(*v*_{1}, *v*_{2})$ 上，并开始向顶点 $*v*_{1}$ 移动。那么点会先到达 $*v*_{1}$，然后由于到达了路径的端点而“掉头”，接着向另一个方向移动到顶点 $*v*_{2}$，再移动到顶点 $*v*_{3}$，然后再次“掉头”，接着移动到 $*v*_{2}$，如此往复。点的速度为每秒 $1$ 条边。例如，经过 $0.5$ 秒，点会移动半条边的长度。

树的每个顶点处都放置了一个秒表。开始时，所有秒表显示的时间均为 $0$ 秒。在初始时刻，所有点同时从选定的位置沿选定的方向在对应路径上开始移动，所有秒表也同时开始计时。当某个点到达顶点 $*v*$ 时，顶点 $*v*$ 处的秒表会自动重置，即从零开始重新计时。

设 $*res*_{*v*}$ 为点无限持续移动时，顶点 $*v*$ 处的秒表所显示的最大时间。Noora 需要选择路径及其上的点，使 $*res*_{1}$ 尽可能小。如果有多个方案都能做到这一点，则需要进一步使 $*res*_{2}$ 最小，然后依次使 $*res*_{3}$、$*res*_{4}$、……、$*res*_{*n*}$ 最小。

请帮助 Noora 完成老师布置的任务。

为了更好地理解题意，请参见样例说明。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）——给定树的顶点数。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$（$1 ≤ *u*, *v* ≤ *n*$，$*u* ≠ *v*$）——一条连接顶点 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$ 的边。

保证输入描述的是一棵合法的树。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数 $*paths*$——你希望选择的路径数量。

接下来的 $*paths*$ 行输出路径的描述：

1. 一个整数 $*len*$——当前路径包含的边数。
2. $*len*$ 个整数——路径中各条边的编号。边按照它们在输入中出现的顺序编号为 $1$ 到 $*n* - 1$。
3. 两个整数 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$——表示你将在顶点 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$ 之间的边上放置点（显然，该边必须属于当前路径），并且点将开始向顶点 $*v*$ 移动。注意，输出边的两个端点的顺序很重要。例如，如果输出“`1 2`”（不含引号），则点将开始向顶点 $2$ 移动；而如果输出“`2 1`”（不含引号），则点将开始向顶点 $1$ 移动。
4. 一个实数 $*x*$（$0 ≤ *x* ≤ 1$）——点与顶点 $*u*$ 之间的距离（即第三部分中首先输出的那个顶点）。

## 评分

评测系统将根据参赛者提供的输出数据生成数组 $*res*$。系统还将根据标准答案生成数组 $*resOptimal*$。仅当对于每个 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）都满足以下条件时，你的答案才会被接受：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2645e3d4fa7e9bd561bf0afa6404827f5aca795a.png)。

## 说明

考虑一个例子。

在初始时刻，各个点的位置如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/94c0e438632ed2dc123fea299e59aea2371e6a06.png)

第一条路径用红色标出，第二条路径用蓝色标出，绿色圆圈表示选定的点，顶点中的棕色数字表示秒表当前显示的时间。紫色箭头表示点的移动方向。

经过 $0.(3)$ 秒后，在秒表重置之前，点的位置如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fd3a46e3dd4a58ac03602f25b15b1306879aa612.png)

秒表重置后：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/accaa16983b2ddaca97bd199ce312425c62ea6b7.png)

开始移动 $1.0$ 秒后：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/69ed4a6243b76dbc1262954fa7e58465098e54a5.png)

开始移动 $1.(3)$ 秒后（秒表重置后）：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/440fc4e17e82c7f8cd6f402d105169db406b6466.png)

最后，开始移动 $2$ 秒后，点回到初始位置。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e96048db37d885902e00d696449f4f5be537b221.png)

这一过程将无限持续下去。
</statement>
